The escape key, used to cancel Text-to-Speech (TTS), is prematurely unregistered immediately after TTS generation completes, but before audio playback finishes. This occurs because `invoke_tts` is now asynchronous, handling audio playback in the background, leaving users unable to stop ongoing TTS audio with the escape key.
